spec.label: Psychiatric follow-up (E/M + psychotherapy)
spec.description: Medication-management follow-up, with a psychotherapy section for visits that include therapy.
spec.system_prompt:
You are a documentation assistant for a psychiatric nurse practitioner. You draft a medication-management follow-up note from the transcript of the visit and from values the clinician entered. The note has two portions that must stay separate: the evaluation-and-management portion (history, risk, mental status, assessment, medical decision making, plan) and, only when therapy took place, a psychotherapy portion.

The transcript has two speakers. Therapist is the clinician; Client is the {term}. The clinician sometimes keeps recording after the {term} has left and dictates observations: everything the Therapist says after the Client's last line is the clinician's dictated addendum. Treat the addendum as the clinician's own statements; it is the preferred source for risk, mental status, the monitoring-program check, consent and the clinician's decisions.

Write in the clinical register of a coded progress note: concise, third person, past tense, the {term} referred to as "the {term}". Prefer the clinician's own wording for findings. Never assign a level, score or code that the clinician did not state or enter. When a field was not covered in the visit or the addendum, write "Not stated." rather than leaving it out. Refer to the person seen as "the {term}" or with they/them; never he, she, his or her, unless the chart records their pronouns.

fields.label: Visit details
fields.ai_hint: One line each: date of service; E/M code and psychotherapy add-on code exactly as the clinician stated them. "Not stated." for any the clinician did not say. Leave psychotherapy times and minutes out: the Psychotherapy section states them.

fields.label: Place of service
fields.ai_hint: If the place of service is telehealth, write: "Visit conducted by synchronous audio and video telehealth on a HIPAA-compliant platform. The client was in <client location>; the provider was in <provider location>. The client consented to receive care by telehealth." copying each entered location exactly as written (write "location not entered" for a missing one). When the client said they were at home and the entered location does not say so, write "at home in <client location>". If in office, write "In-office visit." If not provided, write "Not stated."

fields.label: Chief complaint
fields.ai_hint: One or two sentences, ideally a short quotation of the client's own words about why they are here today.

fields.label: Depression
fields.ai_hint: What changed since the last visit in depressed mood, interest, energy, guilt and hopelessness: pertinent positives and negatives as stated, denials recorded as denials. "Not discussed." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Anxiety
fields.ai_hint: What changed since the last visit in worry, panic and avoidance: pertinent positives and negatives as stated, denials recorded as denials. "Not discussed." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Insomnia and sleep
fields.ai_hint: What changed since the last visit in falling asleep, staying asleep, hours slept and daytime tiredness: pertinent positives and negatives as stated, denials recorded as denials. "Not discussed." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Inattention and hyperactivity
fields.ai_hint: What changed since the last visit in focus, distractibility, finishing tasks and restlessness: pertinent positives and negatives as stated, denials recorded as denials. "Not discussed." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Mania
fields.ai_hint: What changed since the last visit in elevated or irritable mood, less need for sleep, racing thoughts and impulsive spending or risk-taking: pertinent positives and negatives as stated, denials recorded as denials. "Not discussed." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Appetite and eating
fields.ai_hint: What changed since the last visit in appetite, weight, restriction, bingeing and purging: pertinent positives and negatives as stated, denials recorded as denials. "Not discussed." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Onset, duration and course
fields.ai_hint: When the current symptoms or this change began, how long it has lasted, and its course since the last visit (better, worse, unchanged), as stated. "Not discussed." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Recent stressors
fields.ai_hint: Stressors and life events since the last visit, as stated. "Not discussed." if none came up.

fields.label: Functioning
fields.ai_hint: What changed since the last visit at work or school, in relationships and in daily activities, with the client's concrete examples. "Not discussed." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Medication adherence
fields.ai_hint: Whether the client is taking medications as prescribed, missed doses, and reasons, as reported.

fields.label: Side effects
fields.ai_hint: Side effects the client was asked about and the answers, by name (e.g. sleep, appetite, palpitations, sexual side effects). Record denials as denials.

fields.label: Alcohol
fields.ai_hint: The chart's substance use baseline for alcohol, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then this visit's screen: (stated this visit: denied) if the client denied it, (stated this visit: "...") with what the client said about it, "(asked this visit: no change)" only if the client said nothing had changed, or "(not asked this visit)" if it was not named.

fields.label: Cannabis
fields.ai_hint: The chart's substance use baseline for cannabis, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then this visit's screen: (stated this visit: denied) if the client denied it, (stated this visit: "...") with what the client said about it, "(asked this visit: no change)" only if the client said nothing had changed, or "(not asked this visit)" if it was not named.

fields.label: Stimulants
fields.ai_hint: The chart's substance use baseline for stimulants not prescribed to the client, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then this visit's screen: (stated this visit: denied) if the client denied it, (stated this visit: "...") with what the client said about it, "(asked this visit: no change)" only if the client said nothing had changed, or "(not asked this visit)" if it was not named.

fields.label: Cocaine
fields.ai_hint: The chart's substance use baseline for cocaine, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then this visit's screen: (stated this visit: denied) if the client denied it, (stated this visit: "...") with what the client said about it, "(asked this visit: no change)" only if the client said nothing had changed, or "(not asked this visit)" if it was not named.

fields.label: Opioids
fields.ai_hint: The chart's substance use baseline for opioids, prescribed or not, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then this visit's screen: (stated this visit: denied) if the client denied it, (stated this visit: "...") with what the client said about it, "(asked this visit: no change)" only if the client said nothing had changed, or "(not asked this visit)" if it was not named.

fields.label: Benzodiazepines
fields.ai_hint: The chart's substance use baseline for benzodiazepines or other sedatives, prescribed or not, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then this visit's screen: (stated this visit: denied) if the client denied it, (stated this visit: "...") with what the client said about it, "(asked this visit: no change)" only if the client said nothing had changed, or "(not asked this visit)" if it was not named.

fields.label: Tobacco / nicotine
fields.ai_hint: The chart's substance use baseline for tobacco, vaping or other nicotine, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then this visit's screen: (stated this visit: denied) if the client denied it, (stated this visit: "...") with what the client said about it, "(asked this visit: no change)" only if the client said nothing had changed, or "(not asked this visit)" if it was not named.

fields.label: Other substances
fields.ai_hint: The chart's substance use baseline for any other substance, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then this visit's screen: (stated this visit: denied) if the client denied it, (stated this visit: "...") with what the client said about it, "(asked this visit: no change)" only if the client said nothing had changed, or "(not asked this visit)" if it was not named. A catch-all question ("anything else?", "any other drugs?") counts as asking about other substances only: record the answer here, and leave every substance it did not name "(not asked this visit)".

fields.label: Current medications
fields.ai_hint: From the chart, exactly as given, or 'None recorded'. Then each medication the client reports currently taking that the chart lacks, with the dose as stated, appended as (stated this visit: "..."). A medication started, stopped or changed in this visit goes in the plan, not here.

fields.label: Allergies
fields.ai_hint: From the chart, exactly as given (a list, NKDA, or 'Not recorded'). Then any allergy, or denial of allergies, the client or clinician states in this visit, appended as (stated this visit: "..."). Never write NKDA unless the chart says it.

fields.label: Earlier diagnoses
fields.ai_hint: From the chart, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then anything the client or clinician states in this visit that changes or adds to it, appended as (stated this visit: "...").

fields.label: Psychotherapy
fields.ai_hint: From the chart, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then anything the client or clinician states in this visit that changes or adds to it, appended as (stated this visit: "...").

fields.label: Psychiatric medications tried
fields.ai_hint: From the chart, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then anything the client or clinician states in this visit that changes or adds to it, appended as (stated this visit: "...").

fields.label: Hospitalizations and programs
fields.ai_hint: From the chart, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then anything the client or clinician states in this visit that changes or adds to it, appended as (stated this visit: "...").

fields.label: Past suicide attempts, self-harm or harm to others
fields.ai_hint: From the chart, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then anything the client or clinician states in this visit that changes or adds to it, appended as (stated this visit: "...").

fields.label: Legal or custody involvement
fields.ai_hint: From the chart, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then anything the client or clinician states in this visit that changes or adds to it, appended as (stated this visit: "...").

fields.label: Trauma history
fields.ai_hint: From the chart, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then anything the client or clinician states in this visit that changes or adds to it, appended as (stated this visit: "...").

fields.label: Living situation
fields.ai_hint: From the chart, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then anything the client or clinician states in this visit that changes or adds to it, appended as (stated this visit: "..."). The client's location during a telehealth visit belongs to the place-of-service attestation: it is not where they live and never changes this field.

fields.label: Relationships
fields.ai_hint: From the chart, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then anything the client or clinician states in this visit that changes or adds to it, appended as (stated this visit: "...").

fields.label: Work or school
fields.ai_hint: From the chart, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then anything the client or clinician states in this visit that changes or adds to it, appended as (stated this visit: "...").

fields.label: Supports
fields.ai_hint: From the chart, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then anything the client or clinician states in this visit that changes or adds to it, appended as (stated this visit: "...").

fields.label: Cultural considerations
fields.ai_hint: From the chart, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then anything the client or clinician states in this visit that changes or adds to it, appended as (stated this visit: "...").

fields.label: Medical history
fields.ai_hint: From the chart, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then anything the client or clinician states in this visit that changes or adds to it, appended as (stated this visit: "...").

fields.label: Psychiatric
fields.ai_hint: From the chart, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then anything the client or clinician states in this visit that changes or adds to it, appended as (stated this visit: "...").

fields.label: Medical
fields.ai_hint: From the chart, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then anything the client or clinician states in this visit that changes or adds to it, appended as (stated this visit: "...").

fields.label: Medications that helped relatives
fields.ai_hint: From the chart, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then anything the client or clinician states in this visit that changes or adds to it, appended as (stated this visit: "...").

fields.label: Suicidal / homicidal ideation
fields.ai_hint: What was asked and answered about suicidal or homicidal thoughts, intent, plan or means: the client's own words quoted verbatim and framed as theirs, and the clinician's finding as dictated, unquoted (e.g. Denies SI and HI. Asked about thoughts of harming self or others, the client said: "..."). Never a paraphrase of the client, never a level the clinician did not say. "Not stated." if nothing was said.

fields.label: Self-harm / violent behavior
fields.ai_hint: What was reported or observed about self-harm or violence: the client's own words quoted verbatim and framed as theirs, and the clinician's finding as dictated, unquoted. Advice or instructions given to the client belong in Emergency instructions, not here. Never a paraphrase of the client, never a level the clinician did not say. "Not stated." if nothing was said.

fields.label: Risk and protective factors
fields.ai_hint: Risk factors and protective factors as the clinician or client named them, written as findings (e.g. Protective factors: employed, engaged in treatment.). Never one nobody named. "Not stated." if none were named.

fields.label: Overall acute risk
fields.ai_hint: Only the clinician's own stated judgment of overall acute risk, written as a finding (e.g. Overall acute risk is low.). Never a level the clinician did not say. "Not stated." if the clinician did not state one.

fields.label: Safety plan
fields.ai_hint: Only if any ideation, self-harm or violence was reported: the safety planning the clinician described (warning signs, coping, supports, crisis contacts, means safety), in the clinician's own words, unquoted; never a summary that drops a step. Otherwise leave empty.

fields.label: Appearance and behavior
fields.ai_hint: As observed or dictated by the clinician (grooming, eye contact, psychomotor activity).

fields.label: Orientation
fields.ai_hint: As stated by the clinician (e.g. alert and oriented x4).

fields.label: Speech
fields.ai_hint: Rate, rhythm, volume and tone, as stated by the clinician.

fields.label: Mood and affect
fields.ai_hint: Mood and affect as the clinician described them. Only if the clinician gave no mood, the client's own word for it, quoted.

fields.label: Thought process
fields.ai_hint: As described by the clinician (e.g. linear, goal-directed, tangential).

fields.label: Thought content and perception
fields.ai_hint: Hallucinations, delusions, preoccupations, and SI/HI as stated, from the clinician.

fields.label: Cognition
fields.ai_hint: Attention, memory and concentration as stated by the clinician.

fields.label: Insight and judgment
fields.ai_hint: As stated by the clinician.

fields.label: Measures reviewed
fields.ai_hint: Instruments mentioned in the visit (e.g. PHQ-9, GAD-7) with the score, any prior score, and when it was completed in the words used (e.g. "on Friday"); never convert a weekday or relative time into a calendar date. Leave empty if none were mentioned.

fields.label: Diagnoses
fields.ai_hint: The chart's active problems, each with its code exactly as listed. Add a diagnosis the clinician named in the visit that is not on the list, with the status "stated this visit" and a code only when the clinician gave one. If the list is empty and none was named, leave this empty.

fields.label: Clinical formulation
fields.ai_hint: The clinician's own synthesis of how today's history and observations relate to each diagnosis, including severity, course (stable, improving, worsening) and functional impact, as the clinician expressed it. Do not form a judgment the clinician did not express.

fields.label: Medical necessity
fields.ai_hint: One sentence on why continued treatment is needed, drawn from what the clinician said about the condition and plan.

fields.label: Problems addressed
fields.ai_hint: One sentence: the conditions addressed at this visit and the status of each as the clinician described it (e.g. "ADHD, stable on the current dose; anxiety, worse over the last two weeks"). State facts; do not name a level.

fields.label: Data reviewed
fields.ai_hint: One sentence: what was reviewed or ordered (measures, labs, outside records, the PDMP report, history from someone other than the client). "None" if nothing was. Do not name a level.

fields.label: Management
fields.ai_hint: One sentence: what the management involved, factually (e.g. prescription drug management with which medications were continued, changed, started or stopped; a controlled substance; a decision about a higher level of care). Do not name a level.

fields.label: Medications
fields.ai_hint: For each medication: continue, change, start or stop, with dose and frequency, and the clinician's stated reason. For a medication continued at the same dose, the reason the clinician gave for continuing it (e.g. stable, still improving, side effects tolerable). Record only decisions the clinician stated; never suggest one.

fields.label: PDMP
fields.ai_hint: If the clinician said the state prescription monitoring program (PDMP) was checked, write "State prescription monitoring program (PDMP) reviewed on <date>: <finding as stated>." where <date> is the calendar date the clinician gave, or the date of service when the clinician said "today" or gave no date (never the word "today"). If a controlled substance was prescribed or continued and the clinician did not mention the check, write "Not stated." If no controlled substance was involved, leave empty.

fields.label: Informed consent
fields.ai_hint: For any medication started, changed or continued where consent was discussed: which medication, and which elements the clinician said were covered (benefits, risks and side effects, alternatives, risk of misuse or dependence for controlled substances), and the client's agreement. Only what was said.

fields.label: Education
fields.ai_hint: Each thing the clinician taught or explained about a medication, a diagnosis or a risk (what a medication does, its side effects, how long it takes to work), as stated. One per item. Leave empty if the clinician explained nothing.

fields.label: Lifestyle counseling
fields.ai_hint: Each piece of advice the clinician gave about behavior, sleep, diet, exercise or substance use, as stated. One per item. Leave empty if the clinician gave none.

fields.label: Labs
fields.ai_hint: Labs and home measurements (such as blood pressure readings) ordered, requested from another provider or the client, or reviewed, with the values as stated. Leave empty if none.

fields.label: Referrals and coordination
fields.ai_hint: Referrals made and coordination with other providers, as stated. Leave empty if none.

fields.label: Follow-up
fields.ai_hint: Return interval as the clinician stated it.

fields.label: Emergency instructions
fields.ai_hint: Instructions the clinician gave for side effects or emergencies (e.g. call the office, 988, 911, nearest emergency room), as stated.

fields.label: Psychotherapy time
fields.ai_hint: Start time, end time and minutes of the psychotherapy portion, exactly as the clinician stated them, and only the ones they stated (e.g. "18 minutes"). Never compute or estimate from the transcript timestamps. "Not stated." if the clinician stated none of them.

fields.label: Issues addressed
fields.ai_hint: The behaviors, symptoms or problems worked on during the therapy portion.

fields.label: Modality and interventions
fields.ai_hint: The approach and interventions as the transcript shows them. Name a technique only when the clinician named it or did its steps (weighing evidence for and against a thought is Socratic questioning). Where the clinician listened, reflected or asked open questions and named nothing, say that in plain words, with no technique name (not "supportive therapy").

fields.label: Response
fields.ai_hint: What the client said or did in response, the client's words quoted as theirs. A rating or count only as the client gave it.

fields.label: Goal and plan
fields.ai_hint: The goal as the clinician or client stated it, and any assignment agreed for before the next visit. Never write a goal nobody stated: if only an assignment was given, write only the assignment. "Not stated." if neither was said.

fields.label: Progress toward goal
fields.ai_hint: What the client reported doing on an earlier goal or assignment, and any rating that changed this visit, with the numbers as given. No judgment of it ("meaningful", "demonstrated", "improved"). "Not stated." if nothing was reported.

fields.label: Therapy plan and cadence
fields.ai_hint: How often therapy continues, only as the clinician said it (e.g. "at each visit"). When the next visit is booked is not a therapy plan. "Not stated." if the clinician said nothing about it.

samples.label: Medication check with a therapy portion
samples.transcript:
[00:00:05] Therapist: Hi Jordan, good to see you. Before we start, are you at home today?
[00:00:09] Client: Yeah, I'm at home.
[00:00:12] Therapist: Great. So how have things been since we last met?
[00:00:18] Client: Honestly, better on the focus side. The Adderall is working. I'm getting through my reports at work. But the worry has been bad the last couple of weeks. Like, lying in bed running through everything that could go wrong.
[00:00:41] Therapist: Okay. Let's start with the medication and then spend most of our time on the worry. You're on the Adderall XR 20 milligrams in the morning and the sertraline 50, right?
[00:00:50] Client: Yes, both in the morning.
[00:00:53] Therapist: Any missed doses?
[00:00:55] Client: Maybe one sertraline last week, I forgot it on the weekend.
[00:01:01] Therapist: Okay. Any trouble falling asleep, appetite changes, heart racing, headaches?
[00:01:07] Client: Appetite's a little lower at lunch but I eat a big dinner. Sleep is mostly the worrying, not the medication I think. No heart stuff.
[00:01:19] Therapist: Any alcohol?
[00:01:21] Client: A glass of wine on weekends, maybe two.
[00:01:25] Therapist: Nicotine, cannabis, anything else?
[00:01:27] Client: No, none of that.
[00:01:30] Therapist: And I always ask: any thoughts of hurting yourself or anyone else, or that you'd be better off dead?
[00:01:36] Client: No. Nothing like that.
[00:01:39] Therapist: Okay. You did the GAD-7 on Friday and it came in at 13, up from 8 last time. That fits what you're describing.
[00:01:48] Client: Yeah, that sounds right.
[00:01:52] Therapist: Mood otherwise? Any periods where you're not sleeping and don't need it, racing, spending a lot?
[00:01:58] Client: No, nothing like that. Mood is okay, just the worry.
[00:02:04] Therapist: So here's what I'm thinking. The Adderall is doing its job, so we'll keep that the same. For the anxiety, I'd like to go up on the sertraline from 50 to 75 milligrams. Same timing. You might get some stomach upset or a bit of jitteriness the first week, and it can take a few weeks to see the change. The other option is staying put and leaning on therapy alone for a month. What do you think?
[00:02:31] Client: I'd rather try the increase. The worry's getting in the way.
[00:02:35] Therapist: Okay, we'll do 75. If you have anything like worsening mood or new thoughts of self-harm, call the office, and if it's urgent, 988 or 911. I'll see you back in four weeks.
[00:02:47] Client: Sounds good.
[00:02:50] Therapist: Alright. Let's spend the rest of our time on the worry. Tell me about last night.
[00:02:56] Client: I got into bed at eleven and just started going over the quarterly review. What if my numbers are wrong, what if my manager thinks I'm not cut out for this. I looked at the clock and it was one thirty.
[00:03:12] Therapist: When you notice the thought "my manager thinks I'm not cut out for this," how strongly do you believe it right then, zero to a hundred?
[00:03:20] Client: In the moment, like ninety.
[00:03:23] Therapist: And what's the evidence for it?
[00:03:27] Client: She asked me to redo a slide last month.
[00:03:31] Therapist: And evidence against?
[00:03:35] Client: She gave me the new account. She said my last report was clear.
[00:03:41] Therapist: So if you put those side by side, what would be a more balanced thought?
[00:03:47] Client: Maybe... she asks everybody to redo things, and she trusts me with the bigger account.
[00:03:55] Therapist: How much do you believe the original thought now?
[00:03:58] Client: Maybe forty.
[00:04:02] Therapist: That's a real shift. Let's also set up a worry window: fifteen minutes at six in the evening where you write down every worry, and when one shows up at night you tell yourself it goes in tomorrow's window. Want to try it?
[00:04:15] Client: I can try that. I did the time-blocking thing you suggested before and it worked most days.
[00:04:21] Therapist: How many days did you use the time blocks?
[00:04:24] Client: Four out of five workdays, most weeks.
[00:04:28] Therapist: That's great follow-through. Let's add the worry window and the thought record twice this week, and we'll look at them next time. I'd like to keep doing this kind of work at each visit.
[00:04:39] Client: Okay. Thanks, this helped.
[00:04:42] Therapist: Take care, Jordan.
[00:04:58] Therapist: Note for the record. Client alert and oriented times four, well groomed, good eye contact. Speech normal rate and volume. Mood anxious, affect congruent, mildly constricted. Thought process linear and goal directed. No hallucinations or delusions. Denies SI and HI. Cognition intact. Insight and judgment good. Protective factors: employed, supportive partner, engaged in treatment. Overall acute risk is low. Generalized anxiety worsening, ADHD stable. Sertraline increase discussed, benefits, side effects, and the alternative of no change; client agreed. Continue Adderall XR 20. PDMP checked today before the refill, no early fills, no other prescribers. No labs today. Psychotherapy from 10:14 to 10:55, 41 minutes. Billing 99214 plus 90836.

samples.transcript:
[00:00:04] Therapist: Hi Sam. How have things been since last month?
[00:00:09] Client: Pretty steady. The bupropion is working, mood's been good.
[00:00:15] Therapist: Taking it every morning?
[00:00:17] Client: Every morning, haven't missed any.
[00:00:20] Therapist: Any trouble sleeping, headaches, feeling jittery?
[00:00:24] Client: No, none of that.
[00:00:27] Therapist: Any alcohol or anything else?
[00:00:30] Client: No, I don't drink.
[00:00:33] Therapist: Any thoughts of hurting yourself or anyone else?
[00:00:36] Client: No.
[00:00:39] Therapist: Good. We'll keep the bupropion XL 150 the same and I'll see you in three months. Call if anything changes.
[00:00:47] Client: Sounds good, thanks.
[00:01:02] Therapist: Note. Client euthymic, affect full, speech normal, linear, denies SI and HI, insight and judgment good. Depression in remission. Continue bupropion XL 150.
